title: Gifted-kids program with ESP training from Miss Kaur

tellings.quote: And she got me to look into ESP, the psychic phenomenon.

plain: As a boy in a program for gifted children near Vancouver, British Columbia, a researcher named Deep Prasad says a teacher he calls Miss Kaur got him to look into ESP, the idea that the mind can sense things without the usual senses. Prasad tells Michels this as the start of his own interest in psychic phenomena.
